_ai_directive: MANDATORY FOR AI ASSISTANTS: Whenever you modify any plugin, you MUST increment its version by at least one patch step following base-10 decimal rollover at 9 (e.g. 0.1.8 -> 0.1.9 -> 0.2.0, 0.2.9 -> 0.3.0). You MUST synchronize the incremented version in the plugin's manifest (plugin.py) and record both the new version and changelog in this catalog.json.

ai.description: Native terminal AI assistant powered by OpenAI Python SDK with pure CLI interactive tools.
ai.changelog: Added existing configuration auto-detection and preservation in setup wizard; reordered providers with Custom first and international models prioritized; removed parenthetical notes from names and stripped (双列选择) from title.

alias.description: Multi-terminal command mapping translating universal aliases to host shell commands.
alias.changelog: Added multi-language Carapace completion specifications across 7 languages.

autopilot.description: Production process manager and daemon supervisor powered by PM2.
autopilot.changelog: Rewritten with PM2 as core engine: polyglot runtimes, cluster mode, zero-downtime reload, and dynamic autocompletion.

queue.description: Autonomous background task queue and daemon execution manager powered by Pueue.
queue.changelog: Renamed from autopilot to queue (kps queue), added backward compatibility alias.

fuck.description: Command auto-correction tool powered by thefuck.

help.description: Interactive multi-tool query & action router for command cheat sheets, ports, processes, DNS, HTTP, and system info.
help.changelog: Upgraded from tldr-only client to interactive multi-tool query & action router with zero-friction smart auto-inference (ports, processes, DNS, HTTP, stat, locate, sysinfo).

init.description: Project development environment and tool runtime initializer powered by mise.
init.changelog: Added multi-language Carapace completion specifications across 7 languages.

install.description: Unified cross-platform package installer powered by meta-package-manager (mpm) with concurrent streaming search, interactive confirmation, and post-install inspection.
install.changelog: Upgraded to fully adaptive prompt_toolkit layout: dynamically responsive columns, guaranteed 100% closed borders, and zero text overflow.

portal.description: Smart directory teleportation and workspace navigator powered by zoxide and fd.
portal.changelog: Upgraded multi-match selector to interactive prompt_toolkit arrow-key menu ([Up/Down] to navigate, [Enter] to teleport, [Esc] to cancel) without j/k/q bindings.

profile.description: Cross-platform dotfile and shell profile manager powered by chezmoi.
profile.changelog: Dotfile management and workspace profile sync via chezmoi.

rec.description: Command snippet recorder and runner powered by pet CLI.
rec.changelog: Command snippet recorder and fuzzy runner via pet.

shore.description: Fast intelligent mirror source switcher powered by chsrc.
shore.changelog: Added multi-language Carapace completion specifications across 7 languages.

preview.description: Smart terminal preview dispatcher inspired by Yazi's toolchain (bat, glow, jq, xsv, eza, 7z/7zz, chafa, pdftoppm, ffmpeg, magick, resvg), plus native 3-column Miller Columns file manager (fm).
preview.changelog: Adopted Yazi previewer architecture: 7zz/7z piped tarball inspection, jq with bat fallback, ffmpeg video keyframe thumbnailing, magick font specimen rendering, and resvg/magick SVG vector support.

update.description: Scan and update available plugin catalog and completion dictionary.

trans.description: Terminal command output and multilingual translation powered by fanyi (Windows) and translate-shell (Linux/macOS).
trans.changelog: Added native fanyi support for Windows (eliminating translate-shell/gawk dependency on Windows), automated installation via npm/pnpm, and clean output formatting.

lang.description: Instant terminal language, shell culture, and CLI localization switcher.
lang.changelog: Initial release: zero-latency switching between Chinese and English environments (LANG, LC_ALL, PowerShell culture, Kapsel UI).

commit.description: Offline rule-based Conventional Commit deduction and interactive git commit manager.
commit.changelog: Initial release: offline Git status inspection, automatic type/scope/subject inference, and zero-interruption interactive commit workflow.

backup.description: Lightweight zero-pollution file & folder version backup and interactive restoration CLI powered by GitKeep.
backup.changelog: Initial release: zero-pollution centralized git backup storage, bk/backup command interceptor, and interactive TUI version restoration.

mend.description: Diagnostic self-healing health checker for plugin tool dependencies and interactive configuration cleaner.
mend.changelog: Initial release: 4-thread concurrent plugin dependency inspection with auto-fix, and interactive configuration/log/cache cleaner.
